description:
Palmi is your personal AI workspace for iPhone and iPad. Connect your own models for everyday conversations, project work and virtual character chats. Turn ideas into results you can view, refine and share.

THREE WAYS TO USE PALMI
• Chat: Ask questions, write and discuss images. Enable web access when you need online information.
• Professional: Organize work in projects and conversations. Choose standard chat, Goal mode or Deep Research. Break down tasks, use tools and delegate independent work to subagents before combining results.
• Bionic: Talk with Palmi or custom characters, with personalities, memories and fictional diaries that give conversations continuity.

YOUR MODELS, YOUR STYLE
Connect cloud APIs or compatible local network services. Supports Chat Completions, Responses and Messages, with automatic protocol matching. Eligible accounts can sign in with Codex OAuth to import available models.

Fetch model lists, add models and test connections. Reuse plans with primary, multimodal and lightweight roles. Choose a plan per conversation, adjust supported reasoning settings and set a response style.

KEEP MATERIALS AND RESULTS TOGETHER
Professional workspaces hold attachments, source materials, working files and results. Read, create and organize files; extract text and assets from PDF, Office, iWork and supported archives.

View notes, reports and data files, or open generated HTML tools, interactive visualizations and small games. Share results and export project content for further work.

RESEARCH, IMAGES AND LOCAL COMPUTING
Use built-in web search or configure a compatible remote search service. Read webpages and PDFs, follow links and read long documents in sections. Deep Research saves notes, sources and reports for reference.

Understand images with a vision model. On-device OCR extracts text with positions and confidence scores. Embedded Python in Professional mode handles calculations, symbolic math and supported CSV or Excel tasks. Image generation requires a configured Codex OAuth model with image access.

REUSABLE SKILLS, VISIBLE PROGRESS
Import SKILL.md files or ZIP skill packages for global or project use. Built-in skills help create skills and Bionic characters.

See progress, tools, results and timing in an expandable timeline. Add instructions during execution and review approvals. Longer conversations can summarize older context while retaining task state.

CHARACTERS WITH CONTINUITY
Set names, avatars, backgrounds and personalities. Choose instant or natural replies, proactive messages and personality changes. Search chats, browse images, customize backgrounds, pin or mute conversations, and import or export character archives.

Characters can delegate research and analysis; built-in Palmi can also process files in a selected Professional project.

Bionic Basic includes Palmi and up to 2 custom characters, with memory and diary generation. A one-time Bionic Pro purchase raises the limit to 99 and unlocks memory details and editing, links to source messages, diary reading and an inspection panel. Characters and their diary stories and generated images are fictional.

LOCAL DATA AND CLEAR PERMISSIONS
Conversations, files, characters and settings stay on your device by default. API keys and Codex OAuth credentials use Keychain. Request content goes directly to your configured services under their terms and privacy policies.

Choose per-use approval, allow enabled tools or set a policy for automatic review. Device features such as location require system permission. Background processing is limited by iOS.

BEFORE YOU START
Bring your own model service. Palmi includes no general-purpose model weights or third-party credits; Bionic Pro includes no model credits. Service availability, fees and limits depend on your provider. Requires iOS or iPadOS 26.1 or later.
